register: On-record flip census: the published side of every counted computation is CMS's own published boundary values, reproduced bit-for-bit by the documented method at an exhibited input ordering (record-reproducing realizations named per split); the exact side is the stated criterion's result at the same reproducing ordering(s); a star-delta counts only if identical at every reproducing ordering of its split. Splits with no reproducing ordering contribute nothing (one-sided undercount). Estimate-class dollars: enrollment x $400-600 per enrollee-year, single payment-year month per star year, per-year figures are annual, the three-year total is a sum, not a rate; outward rounding on displayed ends; PDP contracts counted, never in the dollar estimate. Sampled: the reproducing set can only grow with more sampled orderings (4/4 reproduction is monotone evidence); deltas could be re-classed ambiguous by a new reproducing ordering.
